verdicts.reason: A: the GROVE wordmark sits under the headline and is set at near-headline size. The badges are scattered with no grid (SUMMER ONLY centred, BACK BY DEMAND far left, FREE DELIVERY tilted in the middle), and the CTA is a tiny pill pushed to the right edge, so the bottom half reads as random fragments. B: the shoe has drifted off its circle and the body copy is shrunk to one tiny line, and BACK BY DEMAND is the same size as the CTA with bolder text, so the two compete. B still uses clear rows and a full-width headline, and its CTA is far more prominent than A's, so it is the less broken of the two.
